name: Fan Shouyi in Europe
summary: A young Chinese Christian goes to Europe with the Jesuit Antonio Provana, an envoy of the Kangxi emperor to the pope. He spends ten years there, is ordained a priest, and comes home after Provana dies at sea. His short Shenjianlu, 'Record of Things Seen and Heard', is the only surviving account of Europe by a Chinese visitor before the nineteenth century.

stops.note: He sails with Provana at the end of winter.
Years of study; he is ordained a priest.
They sail for China; Provana dies on the voyage.
